paragraphs.text: Spectacle Summit is located in the Central Region of Orrithia, on the plane of Arcavios .

The Summit is a rocky canyon suffused with the energies of the elements. Due to the intense elemental activity, the location is an unpredictable environment, to the extent that many mages theorize it may be alive. Prismari hosts its annual arts festival, Summitfest, at the canyon, drawing visitors from across the plane. Temporary structures erected by the school extend throughout the canyon as performance spaces, art galleries, and dormitories.

Summitfest is an annual, month-long arts festival held within Spectacle Summit in the fall semester. The festival takes place within the largest canyon of Spectacle Summit, with many of the activities extending into the surrounding cliffs, rivers, and valleys. It is celebrated with three weeks of spellcasting, hiking, and hard drinking, capped with a showcase at the end of the month. One participant receives The Grand Muse trophy. Around one hundred mostly upper-class Prismari students participate in the festival, with alumni, traveling artists, and spectators joining in to observe the festivities. A student often dies during the festival.

Capstone Stage - The main stage of Summitfest. Rigged with countless elemental spells for spectacle, it is a multipurpose platform for everything from fashion runways and talent shows to theatrical productions and dance-offs.
Euphony Gorge - A twisting and ever-changing river canyon permeated by elemental energies that spontaneously form elementals.

The Muse - A massive, naturally occurring rock formation in the shape of a woman. It is a time-honored tradition for artists to contribute to the Muse. Many Prismari students find their best ideas while under the Muse.

Summitfest Gallery - The gallery is a cluster of wagons and caravans at the edge of Spectacle Summit, close to the Muse and the main thoroughfare through the mountains. Painters, craftsmen, and other magical artisans gather to trade and sell. Experimental performances and parties are a constant fixture in the gallery, alongside displays of more permanent elemental creations, art pieces, market stalls, and an open-air bar.

The Whale Trench - A particularly deep, narrow canyon that serves as a popular migration route for the elemental whales endemic to the area. Summitfest coincides with their yearly migration. The whales are generally harmless constructs unless they are imbued with too much mana.

In the fall semester of 4565 AR , during the Summitfest gathering at Spectacle Summit, Rootha Squallheart , a Prismari student affected by lingering trauma from the New Phyrexian Invasion , experienced a near-fatal fall from a ridge and was rescued by first-year student Glassyk , who was infusing a skywhale from the Whale Trench with mana. Later that day, while festival activities were underway, the same skywhale became unstable and expanded into a massive, uncontrolled construct that caused widespread flooding and structural damage across the festival grounds. Rootha identified Glassyk within the elemental mass and, after initial containment efforts by Dean Nassari proved insufficient, collaborated with the dean by channeling a spell she called the Living Flame. Their combined casting generated a high-intensity magical discharge that neutralized the elemental with injuries limited to minor physical harm. In the aftermath, the event became known as the Night of Flame, sparking a tradition that would carry on to future Summitfests.
